newsitem.title: USA: Republicans take control of Florida state House.
newsitem.headline: Republicans take control of Florida state House.

text.p: Republicans took control of the Florida State Legisalture after Tuesday's election.
This was a first for the party since the days of reconstruction after the Civil War.
Republicans have controlled the Senate for the past two years, but they trailed by six seats in the House of Representatives.
Orlando Representative Dan Webster will take over as Speaker of the House two weeks from now when the legislature convenes for a one day organizational session in Tallahassee.
Gov. Lawton Chiles is now the lone Democratic in the state house power structure.
